purpose: Inspect failures of existing sensor-only models and controls on opened one-pair to two-pair trajectories; this is not independent challenge evidence.

training.observe_policy: evaluator no-op action; noiseless feedback of A,B, selected before state outcomes

evaluation.map_tie_break: lexicographically smallest bit tuple in sorted identity order
evaluation.abstention_policy: Report coverage, exact accuracy among answered and correct/wrong per total query; do not score abstentions as zero probability.
evaluation.joint_brier: sum over all eight three-bit worlds of (represented probability - truth indicator)^2; absent worlds have probability zero
evaluation.description: Every action, including first contact and the observation-only step; no pre-evidence exclusion.

structured_objective: episode-level two-mode contact marginal likelihood plus 0.3 times mean set cross-entropy
flat_objective: mean observed-event joint-world marginal negative log likelihood
constraints: No G0 challenge seed or family is generated or inspected.
Training and evaluation fixtures are open, deterministic factorials; cases share identities and are not independent worlds.

All evaluation local contact and set tuples occur in training; eight evaluation episodes share a complete ordered structured sample sequence with training. The counts describe public fixture overlap, not independent duplication or flat tensor identity.
Report whether each evaluation case's ordered structured contact-and-set sample sequence occurs in training; retain every case in all denominators.

Both training and evaluation include one observe action and eight observed feedback bits per episode; training observe reads A,B at action 1 and evaluation observe reads B,C at action 2. Sensor geometry, action order and the recurrent histories nevertheless differ. Structured inference supplies an observe no-change transition and structured fitting excludes observe targets.
The training observe is a noiseless repeated reading of the prior contact participants after an evaluator no-op; it is not independent sensor evidence and makes no claim about noisy streams.

Training has three entities and zero sensor-error metadata: input columns [3,4,5,9,10,11,15,16,17,21,22,23,27,28,29,35] are always zero, so 336 of 1457 flat parameters receive zero data gradient under Adam with no weight decay; verify those weights remain at initialization. At most 1121 parameters can receive data gradients. Verify the observe feature occurs 64 times in 320 training events and report whether its input weights actually changed. Evaluation also has three entities and zero metadata.
Every evaluated case resets each model's episode state; trained weights and the event table remain fixed, with no test-time learning. Callbacks receive no evaluator case index or future actions.
Both learned models use the same sensor/action histories and 200 optimizer updates, but their objective weights, active parameters, compute, and inference biases are not matched.
The structured model supplies exact belief/persistence machinery, two-mode symmetry, and a numerical cache derived from learned weights.
Evaluator-owned complete truth is used only for scoring after predictions and never passed to model callbacks; Python in-process access does not prove isolation or independent custody.
Record structured feedback status and likelihood for every action, including whether the implementation retained its unconditioned forecast when evidence likelihood was below 1e-15.

Report every seed, case, action, abstention, represented zero and loss floor; aggregate by action position and kind without IID confidence claims. The observe action is reported separately and is not comparable to contact/set coverage.
Record the execution commit, per-model input and weight fingerprints, CPU and software configuration, observed sample counts, optimizer steps, preprocessing time and separately measured fit time.
No calibration, hypothesis selection, admission, cross-architecture superiority claim, blind challenge, or G1 gate is authorized.
